title: Case 014: Direct Debit mandate status
initial_request: I saw a Direct Debit collection to Northmere Water Services on my March statement, but I have not seen another one. Please tell me whether the mandate is currently active; I am not asking you to cancel it or assess what I owe the organisation.
overview: Mara Ellery, the account holder, asked H&V to check the bank-record status of her Direct Debit mandate after seeing a historic collection on her March 2025 statement. The agent checked the mandate record and H&V displayed its current status in the secure portal. This confirms the bank-side status only; it does not establish any obligation to Northmere Water Services.

next_action.summary: The agent's first action was to request a current status check from H&V's mandate journal, without making any change to the mandate.

outcome: The secure portal shows the Northmere Water Services Direct Debit mandate as Active, checked on 14 August 2025. Any obligation to the organisation remains unassessed; the absence of newer collections does not by itself mean the mandate was cancelled.

events.body: Your statement for the period ending 31 March 2025 shows a Direct Debit collection to Northmere Water Services. This is a historic statement entry.
I saw that collection on my March statement and have not seen another one. Could you check whether the mandate is currently active? Please don't cancel it; I only need its status.
For case HV-014, please check the current bank-record status of Mara Ellery's Northmere Water Services Direct Debit mandate. I am requesting a status check only and am not making a change.
I checked the payer-side mandate record on 14 August 2025. The Northmere Water Services Direct Debit mandate status is Active.
Direct Debit mandate — Northmere Water Services — Status: Active. Status checked 14 August 2025.
